Title: Good Morning Face-to-Face at the Desert Oasis

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the current Magic English Voyage art direction, adapted for the desert map. Warm early-morning cream sunlight, soft sand and clay earth tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral-pink accents, soft pencil outlines, visible paper grain, low-saturation colors, gentle imperfect brush texture, cozy quiet emotion. Characters should look warm, clean, attractive, and child-safe: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions, gentle smiles, refined hand-painted character design. It must feel hand-drawn and alive, not glossy 3D or plastic CGI.

Source Situation: Two young children meet face-to-face at the desert oasis in the morning. The sun is low and warm behind the camera side, so both children's faces are softly lit and visible. They look at each other, then turn slightly toward the viewer with friendly open faces and greet each other politely with "Good morning." The meaning of the English expression "Good morning" must be visually clear through morning light, waking-up freshness, a friendly wave, eye contact, front-facing or three-quarter-facing faces, and a warm morning greeting. No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.
